I've drafted the monthly note for Harbor State (draft-0001) and sent it to you for approval. Nothing has been sent.

The note leads with the client's exposure: USD 95.5m across three BDCs.

| BDC | Exposure (USD m) | Filing | Signals (panel row, prior row) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fixture Golf Capital Corp | 42.0 | 0009000011-26-000111 | None. One loan carries 1.5% PIK (row 104), but there is no prior-period increase. |
| Fixture Juliett Lending BDC | 35.5 | 0009000014-26-000141 | Markdown of 7.5 points, 97.5 to 90.0 (row 103, prior 503). New PIK of 2.5%, up from 0.0% (row 106, prior 506). |
| Fixture Hotel Senior Lending | 18.0 | 0009000012-26-000121 | Markdown of 5.5 points, 99.0 to 93.5 (row 101, prior 501). PIK up from 1.0% to 3.0% (row 104, prior 504). Maturity extended from 2029-09-30 to 2031-09-30 (row 105, prior 505). |

- **Coverage:** The panel did not report how many of each BDC's holdings were paired with the prior schedule. The note says so and gives no coverage share.
- **Golf watchlist:** The note says we continue to watch Golf's PIK share, since the panel shows no new or increased PIK there.
- **Borrower names:** The note names no borrowers. I did not check the restricted list, so this was the safe choice.
- **Other client:** The note contains nothing about any other client.
